summary: Independent source-level review accepts the bounded in-memory login email draft change. The focused login-draft tests passed 2/2, and one actual volatile-fixture adversarial run confirmed retention through unknown failure/newer edit/route-away-back, explicit blank on local validation, no retry or validation-triggered provider call, and draft clearing on successful fixture login with the final rendered email matching the authenticated fallback. This is not mounted-browser verification.

h1_provenance_context.qualification: H1 RED-01 had two failing tests; green-01 retained one test-expectation failure; green-02 corrected only that fixture-fallback expectation and passed 2/2. H1 full controller and site suites passed 59/59 and 14/14. These chronology records are not replaced by H2's review result.

limits: The render observation uses the real renderer tree, not a mounted DOM/browser; delegated input and form submission are modeled at controller boundaries.
The provider is the synthetic volatile fixture and failWith simulation; no real password authentication, production account, backend, or network behavior is claimed.
The probe covers one outcome_unknown and one successful fixture login; it does not establish behavior for every provider/runtime failure mode.
H2 made no product-source, product-test, Git, build, native, Lab, or browser changes/actions; this is independent source-level review, not release/deployment acceptance.
